GOV-F-003-S123.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Index Definition
GOV-F-003-S123.description: Define MongoDB schema for Brain locks including lock_id, owner_id, acquired_at, expires_at, and status. Implement TTL index on expires_at and enforce required fields via contract validation.

GOV-F-003-S124.title: Brain Lock Heartbeat and Renewal Mechanism
GOV-F-003-S124.description: Implement periodic heartbeat to extend lock TTL for active processes. Ensure renewal fails if ownership has changed and logs conflict events.

GOV-F-003-S125.title: Brain Lock API Endpoints for Acquire/Release/Status
GOV-F-003-S125.description: Expose internal APIs for lock acquisition, release, and status checks to standardize usage across Brain components. Enforce governance rules and ownership validation at API boundary.

GOV-F-003-S126.title: Brain Lock Observability and Audit Logging
GOV-F-003-S126.description: Implement structured logging for all lock lifecycle events (acquire, renew, expire, recover, release). Persist audit records for governance review and debugging.
